|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3, in date order). It is the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[Kylo Ren's TIE Silencer]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-kylorenstiesilencer-original.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/kylorenstiesilencer.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 pilot. Kylo deploys -3 aboard. While Kylo piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, unless Leia here, once per battle may lose immunity to attrition to 'spin': add maneuver to power.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kylo Ren's TIE Silencer (Errata)]], 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-kylorenstiesilencer-remaster-2024.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/kylorenstiesilencer.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 pilot. Kylo deploys -3 aboard. While Kylo piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, unless Leia here, once per battle may lose immunity to attrition to 'spin': add maneuver to power.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: new art (credit “Image courtesy of FA1RYDUST @ Blend Swap”), new frame and copyright line; same words. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-kylorenstiesilencer.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/kylorenstiesilencer.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 1 pilot. Kylo deploys -2 aboard. May reveal from hand to ▲ Kylo and deploy both simultaneously. While Kylo piloting, Kylo and this TIE are immune to It Can Wait, Rebel Barrier, and attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' Set 24 errata: Kylo deploys -2 (was -3); new sentence letting you reveal the TIE from hand to take Kylo into hand (▲) and deploy both together; the immunity now covers Kylo and the TIE and adds It Can Wait and Rebel Barrier; the ‘spin’ option is gone. The image also prints '''Power 3''' where the earlier images print Power 2 (the PC card data keeps power 2; the wording and stats printed on the card image take precedence over the card data, Bill 12 November 2026, so this version's power is 3). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V10-D-kylorenstiesilencer-20241229-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
